title: Endless Villages
description: Every chunk is filled with villages, creating a unique survival experience focused on exploration and village-based gameplay so turn your Minecraft world into a place where only villages generate.
body:
****Expand your Minecraft experience with this datapack designed to enhance and improve your world in new and exciting ways. It adds more depth to exploration, progression, and survival, making every adventure feel more meaningful and rewarding.****

****With new mechanics, improved features, and expanded gameplay possibilities, your world becomes larger and more interesting than ever before. Whether you enjoy building, exploring, or surviving, this datapack gives you more reasons to play and discover everything Minecraft has to offer.****

****Perfect for players who want a fresh experience without changing the core feeling of vanilla Minecraft, Expansion brings just enough change to make the game feel new again while keeping it familiar.****
